name: openpixo/ink-woodcut
title: Ink & woodcut
description: Carved contours and expressive hatching for tactile folklore-inspired game art.

description_i18n.en: Carved contours and expressive hatching for tactile folklore-inspired game art.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以雕刻般的轮廓和富有表现力的排线，呈现质感鲜明的民间传说游戏美术。

examples.title: Forest guardian emblem
examples.prompt: Generate an original forest guardian emblem using the ink-woodcut art style: an antlered tree spirit framed by oak leaves. Keep the silhouette bold and use only one muted red accent.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 ink-woodcut 美术风格生成原创森林守护者徽记：一位长鹿角的树灵，周围环绕橡树叶。轮廓保持醒目，仅使用一处暗红点色。

examples.title: Folklore item cards
examples.prompt: Create three matching item illustrations using the ink-woodcut art style: a carved wooden flute, a knotted rope charm and a lantern with leaf cutouts. Leave clean space around each object without lettering.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 ink-woodcut 美术风格制作三张配套道具插画：雕花木笛、绳结护符和镂空叶纹灯笼。每件物品周围保留干净空间，不添加文字。

style.prompt: Ink-and-woodcut game illustration with strong carved silhouettes, uneven hand-cut contours and directional hatch marks that follow the form. Dark ink on warm paper tones with a restrained muted red accent. Group shadows into bold connected masses, preserve small open highlights and use visible print-grain texture sparingly so the subject remains readable.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, glossy 3D, smooth airbrushed shading, soft gradients, rainbow color, delicate hairline clutter, clean corporate vector finish, text, signature, watermark

constraints.outline: Carved uneven dark contours with directional hatch marks.
